• Puoi aspettarti un periodo di apprendistato pratico e vario

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks: As a clerk EFZ, you will actively contribute to the successful handling of the administrative tasks We offer: You
• You can expect a practical and varied apprenticeship period
• Your training will be carried out by motivated and competent practical trainers
• We will look after and accompany you personally and individually through the apprenticeship
• You will gain an insight into the exciting and varied everyday life in the hospital We are looking for: from August 2027 a motivated person for the 3-year training as a Commercial clerk EFZ (100%)" />
